name: Singapore — NUS / NTU (5.0 GPA)
notes: Identical 5.0 grade→point table at both universities. F is INCLUDED at 0 in the GPA. Neither university publishes percentage bands for letter grades — do not use Wikipedia's bands. Law/Dentistry/Medicine use separate scales (not covered).

presets.honours_note: 160-unit programmes from AY2012/13; faculties may add requirements. Passed courses may not be repeated.
presets.label: NUS
presets.su_note: Letter hidden, not computed. From AY2021/22, S = D or above (pre-AY2021/22: C or above); only S earns units. Quota: 32 units (20 time-limited + 12 carry-over); cohort rules apply.

presets.fgo_note: FGO replaced S/U from AY2024/25 (NTU Academic Handbook §6.3): A/B/C/D → P (Pass, earns AU); F → NR (No Record, invisible externally); both excluded from CGPA; irrevocable; declared after results in a fixed window. Quota: 3-yr up to 21 AU; 4/5-yr full-time up to 24 AU; part-time up to 21 AU.
presets.formula: CGPA = Σ(grade point × AU) ÷ total AU attempted
presets.label: NTU (AY2024/25+, FGO)
presets.retake_note: Passed courses may not be repeated (§6.1.4); all attempts on transcript (§6.1.5); the F stays in CGPA on retake.

presets.formula: CGPA = Σ(grade point × AU) ÷ total AU attempted
presets.label: NTU (pre-AY2024/25, S/U)
presets.retake_note: Passed courses may not be repeated; all attempts on transcript; the F stays in CGPA on retake.
